newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria inflation falls to 18.5 pct - minister.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria inflation falls to 18.5 pct - minister.

text.p: The annual inflation rate in Nigeria fell to 18.5 percent in April from 22.4 percent in March, according to finance minister Anthony Ani.
He told a seminar in the capital Abuja on Tuesday that the steady decline in inflation since last year was due to "prudent mananagement of resources", local newspapers reported.
Ani said the reduction showed that the national economy was on a recovery course.

But independent economists attributed the drop in inflation to a tight cash squeeze by the military government, which is yet to release funds for many projects contained in the fiscal 1997 budget announced in January.
The government projects that inflation will drop to 15 percent by December and be single digit by the end of next year compared to December 1995 when it was nearly 80 percent.
